The vendor directly providing **LottieFiles** at **lottiefiles.com** is **Design Barn Inc.**.

### Evidence
According to the official **LottieFiles Terms and Conditions** (Terms of Use):
> *"These terms of use are entered into by and between You and Design Barn Inc., (“Company”, “we ”, or “us”). The following terms and conditions, together with any documents they expressly incorporate by reference (these “Terms of Use”), govern your access to and use of the LottieFiles Terms and Conditions page, including any content, functionality, and services offered on or through the LottieFiles website, software, apps, or plug-ins, (collectively, the “Website”), and all other products, services, content or application that link to these Terms of Use..."*

This is further confirmed by the **LottieFiles Privacy Policy**, which states that *“‘Company’ (referred to as either ‘the Company’, ‘We’, ‘Us’ or ‘Our’ in this Agreement) refers to Design Barn, Inc.”*.
